title: Google is refusing to index the UK locale: 46 UK pages folded into their US twins as duplicates, only 15 UK pages indexed, and the whole UK mirror earned 56 clicks in 90 days

evidence.claim: 46 UK pages where Google discarded our self-canonical and selected the US twin (path /uk/X -> /X)
evidence.source: gsc/url-inspection.json (890 records; manifest's 109 figure is stale, file extended 8 Aug)
evidence.value: 42 'Duplicate, Google chose different canonical than user' (41 UK) + 11 'Duplicate without user-selected canonical' (8 UK); 46 of the 53 resolve /uk/X to /X

evidence.claim: Only 15 UK pages are 'Submitted and indexed' vs 232 US
307 of 326 UK pairs are word-identical to their US page
UK earns almost nothing
evidence.value: 368 UK 200-pages: 4,522 impressions_90d and 56 clicks_90d (49 clicks are /uk homepage) vs US 483,430 impressions / 1,168 clicks

evidence.claim: Ahrefs independently flags the same duplication
evidence.value: 389 duplicate URLs in 192 content-hash groups; 183 groups are pure UK/US pairs

impact.estimate: Half the 653-URL sitemap is UK mirrors that Google actively rejects; crawl and index budget is spent on 326 pages producing 56 clicks/90d. hreflang alone has NOT prevented canonical fold-in because bodies are word-identical. Either differentiate UK content or canonicalise UK to US deliberately; the status quo lets Google decide inconsistently.

recommendation: Decision required (Jake/Seb): either (a) accept consolidation - set canonical on word-identical /uk/ pages to the US URL and remove them from the sitemap, keeping the 18 genuinely-different UK pages self-canonical; or (b) invest in real UK differentiation (currency, spelling, UK-specific proof) on the pages worth ranking in the UK. Do not leave 307 identical pairs self-canonicalising; Google is already overriding it on at least 46.

title: VideoObject JSON-LD is missing uploadDate on all video pages - Google flags it as an ERROR on post-cutover crawls, making video rich results ineligible

evidence.claim: 5 /videos/* pages crawled by Google AFTER cutover (5-7 Aug) carry rich-result ERROR 'Missing field uploadDate'
Live-verified 8 Aug: production VideoObject on /videos/employee-experience has name/description/thumbnailUrl/embedUrl but no uploadDate
44 pages emit VideoObject
Ahrefs sees schema validation errors at scale
evidence.value: 'Structured data has schema.org validation error': 370; 'Google rich results validation error': 4

impact.estimate: 34 video rich results were detected in the inspection sample; ERROR-level items are ineligible for the video rich result treatment. Sanity holds publish dates for video docs, so this is a template field addition, not new content.

recommendation: Add uploadDate (ISO 8601 with timezone) to the VideoObject in the TEMPLATE-VIDEO JSON-LD, sourced from the Sanity doc's publish date. Also add duration/description where held. One /videos/ page shows 'Invalid datetime value' + 'missing time zone' warnings - use full ISO format with offset.

title: 434 internal links point at the apex host (cloudemployee.io without www), forcing a 308 hop on every follow - 60% of all links-to-redirects

evidence.claim: 729 link instances from 153 indexable pages target a redirecting URL
434 of 729 are https://cloudemployee.io/... (apex, missing www)
evidence.source: same CSV, Target URL host classification

evidence.claim: 49 more links target the retired /tools/price-comparison-calculator (308 -> /pricing), embedded in blog/compare body copy
evidence.value: top single target at 49 link instances

impact.estimate: Every apex link costs a 308 hop and dilutes the link signal on ~153 content pages. Fixable with one Sanity content patch script (rewrite href host to www / relative) plus a sweep for /tools/price-comparison-calculator and /price-comparison-calculator hrefs. No ranking emergency: targets do resolve.

recommendation: One-shot Sanity Portable Text patch: rewrite internal hrefs from https://cloudemployee.io/* (and http://*) to relative paths, and re-point in-content links at final destinations (/pricing instead of /tools/price-comparison-calculator, current /staff-augmentation/* slugs). Add a lint/verify script so migrated content for customer 2 can't reintroduce absolute-apex links.

title: 51 pages that were noindex on Webflow are now indexable - team member, book-a-call and for-developers pages entered the index surface without an explicit decision

evidence.claim: 51 URLs flipped noindex -> indexable between Ahrefs crawls
evidence.value: 51 rows: 30 team/*, 10 book-a-call/*, for-developers x2, customer-story/travelx x2, technology/android-studio x2, staff-augmentation/best-staff-augmentation-companies-2026 x2

evidence.claim: Live-verified 8 Aug: /book-a-call/seb, /book-a-call/anto, /team/seb-hall, /for-developers all serve meta robots 'index, follow'
GSC still shows 9 of these as 'Excluded by noindex' - stale pre-cutover crawls, will flip as Google recrawls

impact.estimate: Team pages indexable is per TEMPLATE-TEAM_MEMBER design (Person JSON-LD, sitemap). But 10 personal /book-a-call/* pages are thin, near-duplicate booking forms - indexing them was Webflow's explicit non-choice and is now silently reversed. Low traffic risk either way; needs a 10-minute decision, not engineering.

recommendation: Confirm intent per group: keep team/* indexable (deliberate), decide on book-a-call/* personal pages (recommend noindex - thin, duplicate intent with /book-a-call) and /start-hiring funnel steps. Where noindex is chosen, also drop from sitemap.

title: 4 sitemap URLs are 308 redirects, not pages: virgin customer story (x2 locales), price-comparison-calculator, and the deliberately-shadowed arc-dev compare page

evidence.claim: 4 of 653 sitemap URLs do not serve a 200 at the listed URL
Ahrefs sees the same, minus the compare page it crawled differently
Google already treats /tools/price-comparison-calculator as 'Page with redirect'
Sitemap still lists 653 URLs as of 8 Aug

impact.estimate: Cosmetic-to-small: 4 of 653. Sitemap redirects erode sitemap trust signals and generate persistent GSC 'why is this here' noise. The virgin story redirects because the doc was retired; the calculator moved into /pricing; arc-dev is the deliberate live-parity shadow (Tech Debt #55).

recommendation: Remove the 4 from sitemap generation: exclude retired/redirected docs (virgin, price-comparison-calculator) and the arc-dev compare entry while its parity 301 stands. Also add /technology/android-studio (+ /uk twin) which is indexable but absent from the sitemap (Notice-Indexable_page_not_in_sitemap.csv).

title: 28 redirect chains of 2-3 hops, all fixable by re-pointing the first hop at the final destination

evidence.claim: 28 chains longer than one hop
Ahrefs concurs at lower count (different crawl scope)
1 broken redirect, in the dead /ph namespace

impact.estimate: Tidiness, not traffic: every chain resolves to a 200 within 3 hops and 308s pass full signal. Worth collapsing in the tracked redirect tables because chains compound as future URLs move.

recommendation: Collapse first-hop targets to final destinations in site/src/lib/redirects tables (/hire -> /book-a-call, /compare/* -> /alternatives, /book-a-cto-consultation -> /book-a-call/anto, etc). Fix or retire the one broken /ph redirect (target 404s; the /ph namespace is discontinued, a 410 or redirect to /services/software-engineers both defensible).

title: Technology detail pages (190 URLs) emit generic WebPage JSON-LD where the equivalent services pages emit Service - a template inconsistency, not an error

evidence.claim: 0 invalid JSON-LD blocks across all 656 crawled 200-pages; every page carries Organization + WebSite + SiteNavigationElement
evidence.value: 655/655 pages with blocks, invalidBlocks empty everywhere

evidence.claim: 39 services/* pages emit Service type; 190 technology/* pages emit only WebPage
Google's parse errors on 23 blog URLs are stale pre-cutover Webflow crawls; only the video uploadDate issue (TECH-02) survives on post-cutover crawls
evidence.value: 23 error-bearing records crawled before 3 Aug vs 5 after (all video uploadDate)

evidence.claim: Google's Breadcrumbs rich result shows 'Unnamed item' on most detected breadcrumbs
evidence.value: 249 unnamed vs 105 named breadcrumb items (mixed pre/post-cutover crawls; not re-verified against live BreadcrumbList markup)

impact.estimate: No current traffic loss - the markup parses. Aligning technology/* to Service and verifying breadcrumb item names on a post-cutover URL closes the gap between the two catalogue templates. Tech Debt #49 (nav JSON-LD bypasses serializeJsonLd) is a code-hygiene item with no crawl-visible symptom in this data.

recommendation: Add Service JSON-LD to the technology detail template (mirroring services/*). Spot-check one post-cutover Breadcrumbs rich result in GSC UI to confirm item names resolve; if 'Unnamed item' persists on new crawls, fix the BreadcrumbList name fields.

title: A handful of US redirects have no UK mirror, so the /uk/ path 404s where the US path redirects - at least 5 live instances

evidence.claim: Live-verified 8 Aug: /managing-engineers/software-developer-performance-metrics-for-ctos 308s to hub; /uk/ same path 404s. /download/our-internal-hiring-sop 308s to /; /uk/ same path 404s
evidence.value: US 308 vs UK 404 on both pairs

evidence.claim: 3 more pairs in the crawl where the US path redirects and the UK path is a crawled 404
2 of these 404s carry internal or external links
evidence.value: /uk/managing-engineers/software-developer-performance-metrics-for-ctos and /uk/download/our-internal-hiring-sop?utm_source=chatgpt.com listed as 404 pages with inlinks

impact.estimate: Small: ~5 URLs, near-zero traffic. But it is a systematic gap - redirects added for retired US content are not being locale-mirrored - and it will silently grow each time a US doc is retired.

recommendation: Mirror locale in the redirect layer: when a US path gets a redirect, generate the /uk/ twin automatically (redirect to the UK equivalent target where it exists, else the US target). Backfill the 5 known instances.

title: Stale-crawl noise dominates the scary-looking GSC numbers: robots-blocked, noindex-excluded and 404 verdicts are mostly Google's memory of the Webflow site or the dead /ph locale

evidence.claim: 358 of 491 inspected records with a lastCrawlTime were last crawled BEFORE cutover (3 Aug)
All 7 'Blocked by robots.txt' are /live-job-role/* - but live robots.txt only disallows /download-thank-you/, and /live-job-role now 308s to talent.cloudemployee.io
36 'Not found (404)' records are 28 /ph/* (locale deliberately discontinued to talent subdomain), 3 old /blog/*, 3 /live-job-role/*, 2 retired team members
408 of 890 inspected URLs are 'URL is unknown to Google' - inspection targets included historical/known-path URLs Google never had

impact.estimate: No action needed on the stale verdicts themselves - they self-heal as Google recrawls (133 post-cutover crawls in 5 days shows recrawl is underway). Value is negative-space: prevents the synthesis session or a future audit from mistaking these for live breakage. The 108 'Crawled - currently not indexed' (91 US) is the one number to re-measure at the 31 Aug read.

recommendation: No fix. Re-run URL inspection on the same 890-URL sample around 31 Aug and diff coverageState; that diff is the real migration indexing verdict. Decide /ph/*: 404 is acceptable, but a 410 would clear Google's memory faster.

title: hreflang is close to clean: 3 real reciprocity failures out of 326 UK pairs, all already-known edge cases

evidence.claim: 656 pages checked; 9 non-reciprocal, of which 6 are query-parameter crawl artifacts (?page=, ?ref=, ?utm) that emit hreflang pointing at the clean URL
evidence.value: real failures: /uk/compare/cloud-employee-vs-arc-dev (US twin 308s per parity shadow), /uk/team/caitlin-murray (UK-only member, Tech Debt #58), /uk/tools/price-comparison-calculator (US twin 308s to /pricing)

evidence.claim: Ahrefs sees the same 3

impact.estimate: Cosmetic. 323 of 326 pairs are fully reciprocal. Fix rides along with TECH-01's UK decision and TECH-05's sitemap cleanup.

recommendation: Suppress the en-US hreflang alternate on the 3 UK pages whose US twin no longer serves a 200 (or emit it only when the twin resolves). Caitlin Murray resolves itself when Seb answers Tech Debt #58.

title: Duplicate content beyond the UK mirror is a non-issue: the extra ~80 Ahrefs URLs are query-parameter variants that already canonicalise correctly

evidence.claim: 389 duplicate URLs resolve to 192 content-hash groups; 183 are pure UK/US pairs; the 9 remaining groups are utm_source=chatgpt.com, Webflow pagination (?61e47ae8_page=N, ?47af9676_page=N) and calculator params
evidence.value: 9 non-UK-pair groups, all param variants of a canonical page

evidence.claim: Param variants canonicalise to the clean URL and Ahrefs records that as the (correct) 'canonical changed' behaviour
evidence.value: 2 rows, both ?page= variants canonicalising to clean URL, marked non-indexable

evidence.claim: ?page=N pagination is noindexed by design

impact.estimate: None - defenses (canonical + noindex on pagination) are working. Recorded so the synthesis session does not double-count Ahrefs' 389 against the crawl's 307: they are the same UK problem seen twice plus param noise.

recommendation: No action. Optionally note that ChatGPT referrals append ?utm_source=chatgpt.com widely enough to appear in crawls - a small AEO signal for the traffic lens.

title: Crawl-efficiency trivia bucket: >3-param URLs are Next.js image optimizer internals, IndexNow is unused, and the brief's '879 robots-blocked links' did not reproduce in any dataset

evidence.claim: 19 URLs with >3 query params: 13 are /_next/image?url=...&w=&q=&dpl= optimizer URLs, 6 are calculator/pricing state params
Pages flagged for IndexNow: 5,051 in the 6-Aug export CSV, 55 in the later issues snapshot - IndexNow is simply not wired, this counts eligible pages, nothing is broken

The '879 links to URLs blocked by robots.txt' figure in the lens brief could not be reproduced: live robots.txt disallows only /download-thank-you/, and the crawl's internal link graph contains 0 links to /download-thank-you/*
evidence.value: 0 matching links found; figure unverified in available data

evidence.claim: Two snapshots of the Ahrefs audit disagree on several counts (e.g. links-to-broken-page 55-row CSV vs 570 in issues.json)
evidence.source: ahrefs/site-audit/ CSVs (6 Aug crawl, exported 8 Aug) vs ahrefs/site-audit-issues.json
evidence.value: different crawl snapshots; treat CSV folder as the citable one

impact.estimate: Cosmetic across the board. Recorded to close the brief's item 8 honestly rather than inflate it. If Bing matters (Copilot citations are a real channel here), wiring IndexNow pings on publish is a small nice-to-have, not a fix.

recommendation: No action required. Optional: exclude /_next/image from Ahrefs crawl scope to reduce audit noise; consider IndexNow on content publish if the Bing/Copilot channel is prioritised.
